title: Normalized data for component descent of a fixed generic scalar model
statement: For a condensed ring $\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], use scalar realization [def-zl-condensed-scalar-realization] and normalized component and slice inverse images [lem-zl-component-derived-pullback-square]. Define SectionComparison to record a section inverse image with its test-object projection, adjunction mate, module identity and scalar comparison. Define CoverModel for $f:U\to X$, a field-valued point $\eta$, $K$, $P$ and fixed $\alpha:K|_\eta\cong L_\eta(P)$ to record normalized component corners and square, a dualizable component object with its isomorphism to $K|_U$, the descent $\delta$ of the restriction of this same $\alpha$, a component-map splitting, the induced isomorphism after every splitting, and the resulting model $K|_U\cong L_U(P)$. All auxiliary comparisons are explicit composites of the specified module and derived inverse-image comparisons. These existing witness structures are extracted verbatim from the generic scalar-model module to avoid an import cycle with its proof steps.
